string-array.name: loading_message_array
string-array.item: Launching game. May take a while the first time.
You can access help and options by pressing the menu button.
Otherwise, long-press on the screen to access the menu.
The screen is divided into a 3 X 3 grid for touch input.
Tapping in grid areas sends directional keys, center to rest.
Feel free to bring suggestions to the project repo!
